seo.title: Live Sport & Events in Upton upon Severn | Bar 7
seo.description: See live sport, music and entertainment at Bar 7 pub in Upton upon Severn, serving the Malvern Hills and Great Malvern area.

intro.heading: What’s on this week
intro.text: Fixtures and social nights change week to week, but the plan stays the same: sports on screen, good drinks, and a room that gets louder when it matters.

fixtures.title: New Skittle Alley is coming soon!
fixtures.details: We’re getting a brand-new skittle alley ready. Keep an eye on our events page for opening details and weekly skittles events.

events.title: 2 For 1 Sundays
events.details: Carling, Guest Ale, Inch's Cider, Glasses Of Wine and Single Selected Spirits.

events.title: Birthday bookings
events.details: Reserve a table for celebrations, match nights, or work socials.

events.title: Live sport requests
events.details: If there’s a fixture you want to see, ask the team and we’ll do our best.
